quotes.title: TOI-1260
quotes.card: TOI-1260 is a single high-proper-motion K-type main-sequence star in the constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: Its surface temperature is 4227±85 K. TOI-1260 has an orange hue and is too faint to be seen with the naked eye, or a small telescope.
